answer: 1728. Since ord_13(3)=3, the nontrivial 13th roots of unity lie in F_{27} but not in F_3 or F_9, so any element of order 13 in GL(3,3) has irreducible cubic minimal polynomial. The cyclotomic polynomial Φ_13(x) has degree 12, so over F_3 it splits into 12/3 = 4 irreducible cubics, giving 4 conjugacy classes of such elements. For each class, the centralizer has size |F_{27}^×| = 26, so the class size is |GL(3,3)|/26 = ((27-1)(27-3)(27-9))/26 = 11232/26 = 432. Therefore the total number of elements of order exactly 13 is 4·432 = 1728.
